### Fixed
- **An identity-provider outage during sign-in validation answers 503, not 401.** When Dex's userinfo or discovery endpoint answered 5xx or 429, timed out or refused the connection while muster validated a bearer, the request was answered `401 invalid_token`: the client was told its token was dead, and a client that parsed the body as JSON-RPC saw a tool call with an empty answer. mcp-oauth v1.7.2 answers it `503 temporarily_unavailable` with `Retry-After`, as it does a token-store outage; a userinfo rejection stays a 401. ([#1501](https://github.com/giantswarm/muster/issues/1501))
